# Love Our Listings — Luxury Real Estate Agent Directory

> Love Our Listings is a premier luxury real estate directory connecting discerning buyers with top-producing agents across 150+ cities in 33 countries worldwide.

## About

Love Our Listings is operated by Industry Army Marketing. The platform features verified luxury real estate professionals specializing in ultra-luxury homes, waterfront estates, ski chalets, wine country properties, and island retreats. Each agent is hand-selected based on production volume, market expertise, and client satisfaction.

## Coverage

### North America
- **Canada**: Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa, Edmonton, Victoria, Kelowna, Whistler, West Vancouver, and 50+ additional cities
- **United States**: New York, Los Angeles, Miami, San Francisco, Chicago, Seattle, Austin, Nashville, Scottsdale, Aspen, Palm Beach, Hamptons, Malibu, and 50+ additional cities
- **Mexico**: Mexico City, Cancun
- **Caribbean**: Nassau (Bahamas), Grand Cayman, Punta Cana, San Juan, Gustavia (St. Barths), Providenciales (Turks & Caicos), Tortola (BVI)

### Europe
Paris, London, Monaco, Milan, Rome, Lisbon, Madrid, Munich, Geneva, Mykonos

### Middle East & Asia
Dubai, Doha, Tel Aviv, Mumbai, Bangkok, Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo

### Oceania & Africa
Sydney, Auckland, Brisbane, Perth, Nadi (Fiji), Nairobi, Cape Town, Port Louis (Mauritius), Marrakech

## Key Features
- Heart-Shaped Luxury Real Estate Sign — iconic boutique branding for luxury listings
- City-specific agent directories with localized market expertise
- Country-level agent hubs for 33 nations
- Destination lifestyle pages: Waterfront Estates, Ski Villages, Wine Country, Island Retreats
- Premium agent profiles with brokerage details, specialties, and direct contact
